body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs0df0j5mfgg9kn6o2si1ggkcb3vn9kad80oia90_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2udhb5dbl66pj1dbhcjjbcd316gpj9c5km3j7ct9j61hm6tj0cdpb8crn6ipb8ptnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicor61cr0cupb4phkc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3c9ge4o32c9g649fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9tpc5l2akuioa4ih0vq4oja6cr55ikohei2fhng_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h60oj2c1h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z41hn40p45es4ttbqmbinn8drdg1s1o93l5vh6g8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h60oj2c1h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z08niel2cd96b74k4u4jimf2op9r9i7uq4f8jie8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h60oj2c1h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

Herschel Walker

name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: Fox News puts our troops in jeopardy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220909 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220909]
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and Seth Moulton today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220909]
Friend,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.
When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.
We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we’re still short. If we’re going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:
Please, will you split a donation of $27 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220909]
Fox News’ propaganda cannot go unanswered. But it takes significant funding to run a full-scale campaign and take on all of Grassley’s and McConnell’s lies.
I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so whatever you can give today will go a long way.
I am so thankful to have you on the team,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=220909]

We couldn't have put it any better, Peter.

If Ken Calvert were to be unseated by Will Rollins -- an openly gay candidate -- it would be...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50510322/366146974/192312732?refcode=em-9.10.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGE3YzQzNS0yMTMxLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jKEwyI_dQBTxNq8N60kOrDr7P1dX1eERPT14GpOn3P8=)
Here in CA-41, Calvert is remembered by many as the guy who launched his political career with homophobia. The infamous pink mailers he sent to voters early in his career that publicly outed Rep. Mark Takano were just the beginning. Now that he’s been redistricted into Palm Springs, he’s trying to walk back his record to soften his appeal.

**Calvert blames “the times” for his record and claims he has since changed, but his attacks on the LGBTQ community have not.** He voted against the Matthew Shepard hate crimes bill. He voted against gay adoption. He voted to keep us out of the military. Just last year, he voted down the Equality Act, allowing employers to continue to fire employees simply for being LGBTQ.

Sam is right. #
Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have poured into pro-abortion groups.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups accross the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade at the end of the battle, when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate 100 people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach 34,000 moms before it’s too late. Will you take a stand with us? Give $10 right now:

**[https://give.liveaction.org/stand-up-to-big-abortion/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=9e60125b848049e088ccae42e2ed5d9a&_e=VMsRprQVPROl4kVMN8r_SriJJzIvWFfE2-KHN2o8A3ZnHax2QSlZr6djMKvaDPKG3w_3X2QQNITc5iPb7Qfaw9d1sHs1EpbFPpYGMHtAjOSyK4lgrQH0NqxMnlQGZZIFbgPLygZVEOwywapKaw_eoh613JF9Ca03aur1bjaSpKblmvbxDhloLqbRut4AGSLRGnNnT7_aZqL-R-jvPXKe1R5W3cyJ_-j0Ify4H37NOkH-w1GBlrJ6DKAaMeWBpjS2oug-MSBZNjDdqe1zn-iOfZWdXYPjmpdWTzqQ3qBiLLn6psikWoM2QUt-eXpLhCrT11j8qHlvjrlqQOATLumIcmYbI4k17Pi70Ki6uovvdTU%3D)**

Friend of Life - this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court’s ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls are showing that Americans are increasing in their support of Abortion rights. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working and if we don’t move quickly, all of our progress the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your gift RIGHT NOW of as little as $10 will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother’s wombs: **[https://give.liveaction.org/stand-up-to-big-abortion/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=9e60125b848049e088ccae42e2ed5d9a&_e=VMsRprQVPROl4kVMN8r_SriJJzIvWFfE2-KHN2o8A3ZnHax2QSlZr6djMKvaDPKG3w_3X2QQNITc5iPb7Qfaw9d1sHs1EpbFPpYGMHtAjOSyK4lgrQH0NqxMnlQGZZIFbgPLygZVEOwywapKaw_eoh613JF9Ca03aur1bjaSpKblmvbxDhloLqbRut4AGSLRGnNnT7_aZqL-R-jvPXKe1Tu-wJgH72NH9gOJOMpQ6vvzS_VqkWM3un6gZYi7o3TPAUrrEsJtCt52zjIXsm4VakE75oNTo2qFze7uk1W44l1qZPkZ86Npq57jhagha3yoWwtGLZeK2kT9jSD0rN8Yyid-KmcF9BcPSd5EytlQFyo%3D)**

Your unwavering conviction and commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We will prevail and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

Making free school lunches available to all kids kept their children from going hungry.

Unfortunately, the cold bureaucracy that denied kids a hot meal before the pandemic has returned. And even "reduced price" meals can be difficult to afford as some working families still struggle to make ends meet.

That’s why Bob is fighting for the return of free school lunch for all. But he needs your help.

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi3ngrp0lslsf4bs6ut9f9erojqkl77pnfr1fc7o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u5hbctr0seqe2d3m61pmbd70eoo71opjcaqb4dbm6ior8c3im8r72c9k6crbatpnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicor61cr46up70pjks2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8iv0)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zapuje4kujr27ioua5jo5ffan7jvue10ohkm31jo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z467smqv461qlp3r8jkumtdcss2dtn38e8405ga8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zr9bf96ihug2cjd303jtdq5l11ncrtqd782rs1m8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2egajdo5ogjj4ierercerqmebap96kg8k24verg_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb428efgplmuvab9uhccgb0jlp0sl3bdhf6jioj0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn5sda76cu9jt02uhctdcppkivd4qfj818tgh2pg_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4dvu888t176ctbdtku2db7lo182um9980962qso_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z45ha0r2gp865i7j4brcodvijq75sgae281o80g8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor0s9h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

clean_body: This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. story.")**__
My name’s Tiffany Smiley. I’m a mom of three, veteran’s wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I’m running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85794%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sckNo%2bmZK6hrQMJnqmfpog&sysid=1 "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I’m running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they’ve been stuck with for _years_.

It’s time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I’m the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I’m getting nervous. We’re _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85705%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OaZ9nchk2ifrjxof1F%2fOtA&sysid=1 "Can you chip in any amount to help me take
the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---
| | [SUPPORT TIFFANY](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85706%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KZwfLqSpS0imD%2fmqzKN9mQ&sysid=1 "SUPPORT TIFFANY")
---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85707%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tZHQvE812EU8drd%2b5%2fJxTQ&sysid=1 "To victory, Tiffany Smiley")
---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85708%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKvMPhAgWrOD3j0GMBlAxA&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85709%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ukyNm71Dki2%2bNoghO1a%2f1A&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85702%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b0e07RIXwvYhlbL3hkH5ww&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85703%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5%2bMFzVaEjlkPkpwgckbtzA&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

name: =?utf-8?Q?Douglas=20Carswell?=
subject: The Queen & America - an update from your favorite think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132608?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,

**I was sorry to hear that the Queen died this week.** She sat on the throne since 1952, when Harry Truman was in the White House.

**Just imagine if the same person had served in the Oval Office for all that time? Losing her seems like a big deal.** Like almost everyone else, I cannot remember a time when Elizabeth II was not there.
---
|
---
| I met the Queen on a couple of occasions, including one time when I was invited to tea with her - alongside the Prime Minister, Archbishop of Canterbury and the Speaker of the House of Commons – to mark her 90th birthday. (Being the only guest to arrive at Buckingham Palace on foot, it took a while to persuade the doubtful policeman at the gate that I really was on the invitation list....).

**Being a Brit living in America, inevitably I get asked what I think about the British system of monarchy compared to the US republican system. **

I am a massive admirer of the American Constitution, with its republican virtue, checks and balances and careful dispersal of power. **What the Founders crafted in that old courthouse in Philadelphia in the summer of 1787 was a near perfect answer to that age old question of how to limit power.** It has made America the most successful republic in human history.

**But the British, in their more haphazard way, have also found an answer to that same question of how to limit power.** Having a hereditary monarch as the source of authority, but devoid of any political power, has served the UK well. The system certainly worked under Elizabeth II – for which we Brits are grateful.

For seventy years, politicians came and went. Various crises came and went. **The Queen remained a constant.**

**In Britain it is possible to jeer the government, but cheer the head of state.** You can be passionately opposed to whoever happens to hold elected office, yet still respect the person that personifies the nation. That is why the Queen was such a unifying figure. In an era when politics is ever more divisive, there is something to be said for that.

Here in United States, the most senior elected leader is the head of state. This can mean that a great deal of political scorn and vitriol ends up being aimed at the person that personifies the Republic – with potentially damaging consequences for the Republic. **We need to rediscover how to disagree with the President, while at the same time respecting the Office of the President of the United States of America.**

I discussed this in more detail on the Jeff Katz Show, and you can listen here:

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

>From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5j028mpsl3hinsb929n17f05cvlar8baak4k0t0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2orqt82pm1kg7fh1va6p2j504qeutn9jetoa1k0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---
| | [SUPPORT TIFFANY](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9avook9ea098pamskni7h5nn6k6sbnneb02c1qo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "SUPPORT TIFFANY")

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuppb2oqr4uvk3297qldd10olhus8kqb18dsrjgo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zirrcbm8379tk8u8sbhlraj87omuvd3dc1mludco_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdjkgl96b59ivgrepke4s72lold1nfs3tsmvc638_rp22sh2s8i66or2c3h6aor5cjh2bs "Step up now!")**_

| | | Pundits said it was impossible for a Democrat to win in Alaska, but [**Mary Peltola proved them wrong, beating Sarah Palin -- and**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3632ba4b-c4b7-4e3b-886b-e7fd00a622e9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[**LeftAction ®**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93f8acbe-5a8b-40ae-83bc-814b04bc1f74/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[was proud to do its part](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1715ca8e-489a-415b-bd89-1b0a26402c4d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), arguing this was winnable, and driving a surge of last-minute grassroots donations**. Thank you to all who gave! Next we're focused on [Pennsylvania](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb916c6b5-8ff2-4253-b320-594550a724d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), [Wisconsin](https://default.salsalabs.org/T22d2a17d-3bc1-41e7-b233-22dfab2735d1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), [North Carolina](https://default.salsalabs.org/T83c0ee2a-fdf0-4c63-8460-56a10637f453/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and [Florida](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2244403e-6d37-4388-a837-06964c3ff9ab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (and we're constantly monitoring more). Now, we know you're getting a TON of donation requests, but [**here's why you should give to LeftAction**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta8ea57b2-a476-463e-a971-89ef398c7940/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9):
* LeftAction® partners with a range of progressive groups and candidates, helping to match them up with activists with a demonstrated passion for their causes. Like matchmaking, only different.
* When they (right-wing nuts) go low, **we get tough and call bullsh*t**. Seriously, we’re a “no snowflake zone.” We fight back against stupidity and misinformation, and fight hard.
* We’re 100% focused on getting results. We support good people in winnable races. We don’t support candidates who are already a “sure thing” or “lost causes.” **We spend money and energy where it counts.**

So help if you can, [give as much as you can](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3f90c637-5b51-4a54-b3b1-5eaf77811602/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and let’s make it a blue wave in November (and beyond)!

body:
Democracy is on the ballot this fall. | | Team,

I’m Wes Moore, and I’m running for governor in the great state of Maryland. I want to talk about my race and what’s at stake.

It’s undeniable that there’s a lot of political division in our country right now and a lot to be concerned about in this moment. But I know if we come together, regardless of party or background, we have a lot to be hopeful about.

While my opponent is focusing his time and energy on disparaging the nation’s top law enforcement agency and even threatening to use our state’s police and military against the President, _I’m focused on how to bring Marylanders together and lift each other up._

**We’re not just going out and asking Democrats to vote for us. We’re going out to every part of the state and asking all Marylanders to join our movement.**

When I led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan, one question I never once asked my soldiers was, “What’s your political party?” _It didn’t matter_. We had one job, one goal, one mission. And the same goes for this election.

We must unite as Marylanders to win not just this November’s election but this critical moment in our state and nation’s history.

In the military and throughout my career in public service, I have always led by bringing people together. **I will be a governor for all Marylanders, not one who seeks to divide and tear people apart.**

Hi folks,
This year, I’m running to be Florida’s next governor — which means I’ve also left my current job as the U.S. representative for Florida’s 13th District.
As I made this decision, I was reminded of my first time running to represent Pinellas County. We were up against a Republican incumbent, and we succeeded in flipping this seat blue through hard work, connecting with our community, and leading with respect.
**This midterm election, we are up against a tide of Republicans trying to take away that success. It won’t be an easy fight, so we need a proven leader to take on this race. That's why I am proud to endorse Eric Lynn, the Democratic nominee for the 13th District. **
Eric is a leader, first and foremost. He knows not just how to listen to his community, but also how to deliver results. He understands the needs of Pinellas County, and the reforms we need on issues that matter — like healthcare, protecting our environment, and bolstering our economy.
**Eric and I both grew up in this district, we’re both proud to have dedicated our lives to public service.** From knocking on doors in St. Pete all the way to the Obama Administration, Eric consistently puts his responsibility to others first.

He’s exactly the kind of politician we DON’T need in Congress. Masters is dangerous – he’s promoted Trump’s election conspiracies and has gone so far as questioning the validity of 9/11. But none of that is stopping the Republicans from spending millions of dollars to help him beat Mark Kelly. Every seat counts this cycle, do we have your support to protect our democracy? body:
We have a lot of ‘room for improvement’ on civic education

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50519764/366176909/-632654605?refcode=EM_FR_220910BacktoSchoolRe_N_KK_90DO_4_G_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY0MTgzOWVmLTM4MzEtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9iaQwSubfwP82a0smiownMjthyIq_OndxTksX9K5q5k=)
| Fellow activist,

As Pennsylvania youth return to school, it’s crucial we keep their civic engagement and education in mind — because right now, we’re failing them.

Only 1 in 4 of the Commonwealth’s high school students who are eligible to vote are actually registered. That’s the statewide average. But when you look at the areas surrounding Allegheny and Philadelphia counties, that number is down to less than 15%. Areas such as East Allegheny, McKeesport, and the City of Chester are **under 7% registration rates for high school students who are eligible to vote.**

Low youth participation is **disastrous** for our democracy and young people alike. Areas such as East Allegheny, McKeesport, and the City of Chester are under 7% registration rates for high school students who are eligible to vote. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hello Derek,

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220910_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=6733%2E1862389%2E5h5qK8 ]In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to donate to our campaign to
build One Georgia — where every Georgian has the opportunity to thrive.
But before that, I wanted to share a story with you about a $20 bill.

My high school debate team was the only one in the southern half of
Mississippi, so we would travel to New Orleans to debate other teams.
These trips were big deals because we got to spend the weekend away in the
city.

Unlike the other kids on the trip, I didn’t come from a family with a lot
of money to spend on fun trips. You see, my father was a shipyard worker
and my mother a college librarian — who sometimes made less than the
custodian who worked there. In a sea of middle-class students, we barely
got by.

Despite that, my parents always handed me a $20 bill for incidentals every
Friday morning before I left. But that $20 weighed heavier than it did for
most students that got to participate in debate.

It meant that one of my siblings wasn’t doing something they wanted to do
that weekend. It meant that my parents gave up something they needed at
the store that week. So to me, that $20 bill meant that I had to do
everything in my power to save it.

When my friends went out to celebrate on those debate nights, I made up
excuses like homework or book reports to avoid going out and spending that
$20. I was sure my parents would be proud of me — for saving $20 for them
and the rest of my family.

But when I showed my parents that $20 bill at the end of the season, I
told them how I avoided my friends to never spend their money. I explained
how I thought they would want me to save that money. I thought they would
be proud. But they weren’t. That’s when my mom told me:

“Stacey, we gave you that money because we knew you needed to be with your
friends. We wanted you to have opportunities and new experiences. We know
you didn’t have as much as everyone else. But our job was to invest in
you, so one day, you could have more.”

That’s what I failed to consider. I didn’t understand that my parents made
sacrifices for me because they wanted me to thrive — not just survive.

Right now, we are in a moment that takes me back to that day. Georgia has
a $5 billion surplus that Brian Kemp is hoarding. We’re told that this
money needs to be hidden away — that Georgians are not entitled to
Medicaid expansion or affordable housing or support for small businesses.

As governor, I will ensure we invest that money into Georgians instead of
stashing it away only to give $10,000 tax cuts to the rich. Because I’m
running in order to open the doors of opportunity for people all across
our state — regardless of their background or zip code. We deserve it.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220910_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=6733%2E1862389%2E5h5qK8 ]But I need your help to get there,
Derek. I’m humbly asking you to
invest in our campaign so that we’re able to invest in Georgia. Can you
chip in to my campaign right now? Anything you can give — a $20 bill or
whatever you can afford right now — will make a real difference.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220910_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=6733%2E1862389%2E5h5qK8 ]DONATE

Thanks for sticking with me,

Stacey Abrams

When my friends went out to celebrate on those debate nights, I made up excuses like homework or book reports to avoid going out and spending that $20. I was sure my parents would be proud of me — for saving $20 for them and the rest of my family. But when I showed my parents that $20 bill at the end of the season, I told them how I avoided my friends to never spend their money. I explained how I thought they would want me to save that money. I thought they would be proud. But they weren’t. That’s when my mom told me: “Stacey, we gave you that money because we knew you needed to be with your friends. We wanted you to have opportunities and new experiences. We know you didn’t have as much as everyone else. But our job was to invest in you, so one day, you could have more.” That’s what I failed to consider. I didn’t understand that my parents made sacrifices for me because they wanted me to thrive — not just survive. Right now, we are in a moment that takes me back to that day. Georgia has a $5 billion surplus that Brian Kemp is hoarding. We’re told that this money needs to be hidden away — that Georgians are not entitled to Medicaid expansion or affordable housing or support for small businesses. As governor, I will ensure we invest that money into Georgians instead of stashing it away only to give $10,000 tax cuts to the rich. Because I’m running in order to open the doors of opportunity for people all across our state — regardless of their background or zip code. We deserve it. [ ]But I need your help to get there, Derek. I’m humbly asking you to invest in our campaign so that we’re able to invest in Georgia. Can you chip in to my campaign right now? Anything you can give — a $20 bill or whatever you can afford right now — will make a real difference. [ ]DONATE Thanks for sticking with me, Stacey Abrams +---------------------------------+ | PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR | +---------------------------------+ Abrams for Governor 931 Monroe Dr NE Ste A102 #363 Atlanta, GA 30308 United States Contributions to Abrams for Governor are not tax deductible.

clean_body: He’ll stand up to the powerful few to fight for working people, root out political corruption, elevate our voices in the policymaking process, and prioritize what is best for working people. | | | On Tuesday, voters in Rhode Island’s 2nd Congressional District will have the opportunity to elect progressive champion David Segal to Congress. As inflation soars, bills skyrocket, and wages remain stagnant — we need a representative who has a unique, proven record of taking on the corporate interests and wealthy elites stalling the progress necessary to ease the cost-of-living crisis that's burdening all of us. And David’s running to do just that. He’ll stand up to the powerful few to fight for working people, root out political corruption, elevate our voices in the policymaking process, and prioritize what is best for the people of Rhode Island and beyond. And he’s the strongest choice to take on the Republicans and win in November as well. But he’s running a 100% grassroots, people-powered campaign, and he needs your support to make sure he reaches as many voters as possible in RI-02. Corporate special interests rule the day in Washington — and David knows that in order to realize any real change for working people in this country, Congress needs to address the rules that allow corporations to trample over everyday people. That’s why rooting out the political corruption that’s barring that from happening is one of David’s top priorities. As a legislator and grassroots organizer, he has a track record of serious dedication to defending and protecting the people of Rhode Island from corporate predators. He’s taken on powerful interests, broken up big monopolies, fought for worker's rights, and demanded fairer taxes for everyday people. And we have no doubt that he’ll bring this commitment to working people and their families to the House floor. With only three days left until the Rhode Island primary election, we need to make them count by ramping up our get-out-the-vote organizing efforts. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? Fellow Conservative,

More than ten years ago, I stepped off the bus and into Officer Basic Training to become a Marine.

During Officer Basic Training, I went through weapons and combat training, extensive military history classes, and drill – but beyond all the physical training, I was taught that **everything is earned, never given**.

After countless hours, too many pull-ups to count, and hard work – I was commissioned as an Officer, got my official pin, and earned my spot in the Marines. It wasn’t easy. _Things that are great rarely are._

Today, I’m training to serve my country in a different capacity. Instead of weapons and combat training, I’m knocking on doors, and talking to constituents. Rather than history lessons, I’m sending emails just like this one. I subbed out pull-ups for putting up campaign signs.

Hello, everyone!**First, I wanted to say thank you from the bottom of my heart. I am so grateful for the support that you all have given me and my team in this race.** I can tell that folks in Virginia's 8th Congressional District are ready for change.**That's why I'm running: I achieved my American Dream and I want to help others achieve theirs.** I'm running because I know this district is not represented well. Bad vote after bad vote keeps piling up and making your lives worse. Make no mistake: so much of the current mess we are experiencing is because of bad federal policy.I spend my days out talking to people in our community, and it's impossible to ignore. Their lives are harder than they should be.So I'm running full speed ahead until Election Day. We have 2 months left to make history!**This is my personal request for assistance from you in the few short days we have left**.**Now is the time to pitch in!**

* [**DONATE**](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=c630fe14a3&e=22db41c18e)**. There is no better way to help us get the word out.**

* **Attend an event.**[**Click here to see what we have coming up**](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=3db974c461&e=22db41c18e)**\-- including events tomorrow and Monday!**

* **Make sure that you and your friends have followed and liked our social media accounts:**[**Facebook**](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=344428bf50&e=22db41c18e)**.**[**Twitter**](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=0d5621f4f8&e=22db41c18e)**.**[**Instagram**](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=694a3869dd&e=22db41c18e)**.**

Will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton and help us pull ahead of Dr. Oz? **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50524580/366183848/934264986?refcode=220910&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTc0NDI1Ni00MDMxLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_x8geOV2nKSxh1YZSqAjN0JulgJ5nMPZlXoMwxX0yRk=) [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50524583/366183849/-1896278260?refcode=220910&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTc0NDI1Ni00MDMxLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_x8geOV2nKSxh1YZSqAjN0JulgJ5nMPZlXoMwxX0yRk=)
Let me first say I’m so grateful for this team. We just had a killer end-of-quarter grassroots fundraising push, all thanks to yinz guys. 🥰 So I hate to come right back to your inbox with another ask. Seriously. But here are three reasons why, as soon I saw Nate’s new forecast, I knew I didn’t have a choice:
1. 538 has the entire Senate rated as a toss-up!!! Yep, Dems staying in control of the Senate could come down to a single race (ours).
2. They’re projecting a vote margin of just 0.3% in our race. Doing the math, that’s like, a few thousand PA voters at most. That’s the kind of *tiny* margin that could tip either way purely based on how hard we campaign.

**Arkansas deserves much better than what my opponent has to offer. And Maryland deserves Wes Moore’s leadership — with his experience, vision, and path to expand work, wages, and wealth for every family.**

clean_body: | | | | | An America United this week announced contributions to pro-law enforcement and tough on violent crime gubernatorial candidates across the country. Governor Hogan has been a national leader on supporting our men and women in law enforcement, enacting a $500 million re-fund the police initiative while the far-left was calling for them to be defunded. Earlier this week, Governor Hogan held a in Portland, Oregon with Republican gubernatorial nominee Christine Drazan. In recent weeks, Governor Hogan also held law enforcement roundtables to promote in Nebraska and Iowa. On Monday, Governor Hogan wrote in a , “with violent crime rising across America and police recruitment, retention and morale at all-time lows, it’s important that we begin reversing the damage by electing pro-law-enforcement leaders.” An America United has made contributions to the following candidates: Oregon Republican gubernatorial nominee Christine Drazan: In 2020, Oregon was one of the centers of the defund the police movement. A former Minority Leader of the Oregon House of Representatives, Christine Drazan has released a Roadmap for Oregon’s future that proposes to “regain the trust and confidence of law enforcement, fully fund state police and increase the number of law enforcement officers with competitive salaries and hiring bonuses.” Nevada Republican gubernatorial nominee Sheriff Joe Lombardo: After 26 years serving in the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department, Joe Lombardo was elected Sheriff of Clark County, Nevada in 2014, reducing overall crime in Clark County by 16.9% between 2015 and 2021. Sheriff Lombardo “believes fully funding the police is essential to public safety, and he will always support Nevada law enforcement.” Georgia Governor Brian Kemp: While Georgia Democratic gubernatorial nominee Stacey Abrams co-chaired a group that has supported defunding the police, Georgia Governor Brian Kemp has been a strong supporter of law enforcement, recently signing seven bills into law all focused on supporting the recruitment of officers and creating tougher punishments for criminals.” New Mexico Republican gubernatorial nominee Mark Ronchetti: New Mexico gubernatorial nominee Mark Ronchetti is running on a platform to fund and support the police, end catch and release, and target dangerous illegal drugs. In a trip to Oregon this week, Governor Hogan Republican Gubernatorial candidate for a roundtable to discuss solutions to combat violent crime, homelessness and promote public safety. Governor Hogan highlighted the similarities in the failures of the one-party control of Oregon, similar to that of Maryland before Governor Hogan took office in 2014. Here's What They're Saying About The Trip: “Maryland Republican Gov. Larry Hogan is enthusiastic about the GOP’s chances of winning Oregon’s gubernatorial race, predicting relentless crime could drive voters to flip the state red and elect Republican Christine Drazan. ‘Portland is a poster child for far-left policies run amuck,’ Hogan told ‘America’s Newsroom’ hosts Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino Thursday after visiting the city.” “As elements of his party feud over the FBI’s search of Trump’s Florida estate Mar-a-Lago, Maryland’s Republican Gov. Larry Hogan is...launch[ing] a new ‘tough on crime’ offensive, Axios has learned.” “Republican Christine Drazan made an appearance in Portland yesterday. She was joined by Maryland Republican Governor Larry Hogan, and a lot of the talk focused on violence that has been apart of Portland the past few years, as well as the role of local law enforcement.” “Politics in Portland saw national interest on Tuesday...Republican Maryland governor, Larry Hogan, joined GOP Oregon gubernatorial candidate, Christine Drazan at an event just down the street...The moderate Hogan says he is supporting Drazan because he believes she embodies the same values he has when tackling community safety.” “In 2014, voters in deeply Democratic Maryland shocked the nation by electing Larry Hogan, only the second Republican to hold that state’s highest office in the past half-century. Hogan, who visited Oregon this week to campaign for Republican Christine Drazan, believes Drazan can do the same. ‘You can change a state when people get to the point where they’re fed up, and I think that’s where your state is now,’ Hogan said. Drazan and Hogan joined a group of Oregon business owners, crime victims and people who work with homeless Oregonians to discuss law enforcement and homelessness on Tuesday afternoon. The two issues are top concerns for voters, surveys show. Drazan, the Republican with the best shot at Oregon’s governor’s mansion in decades, is leaning hard on Oregonians’ frustration with homeless camps and rising violent crime rates in her pitch to Oregon voters.” | | AN UPDATE FROM TWITTER | | | Marylanders join the nation and the world in mourning the passing of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II—an iconic and beloved leader whose long life of service commands immeasurable respect and admiration. name: Conservatives Give
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97a4b93c1ba46b4b84dc0597e8e80df&_e=xUrftfK2XJNNfTBKTJVDGCW0L0us_5_ZCebamklgCxHyMvZMaIl37RBE2r7wVjL9vH9f_H0dnkErbgYGxCunb66ByJCtt0qwA7X50ZtxP69GVXfxNm89TDUm5Fncbm_fd8JIn0-hjhv_cY3XbAZj5MKi5TT-NB-L2cHJ_RuFGOOs2wn0-JJfEpc7DpKSWthyrORoywf1tQkok6W7SUWZvXhex8KsOaBmGdZetrS-udClyTc-KcVyf4ieuKLsdPNy4NJmqEqZR7xXQUcQqwvXTlscuT2E6HYdGkoS-SYnyioswvk90CVsZ4XaF4mG6GkfbcB3E2PzRzFmwbeuwz8YRADjQVFBlMwL-8Yoz9m8vpByPLKWWRaUWtyqKt2nz5YtzjmbvLQ7t23ROWE2w1WSYw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97a4b93c1ba46b4b84dc0597e8e80df&_e=xUrftfK2XJNNfTBKTJVDGCW0L0us_5_ZCebamklgCxHyMvZMaIl37RBE2r7wVjL9vH9f_H0dnkErbgYGxCunb66ByJCtt0qwA7X50ZtxP69GVXfxNm89TDUm5Fncbm_fd8JIn0-hjhv_cY3XbAZj5MKi5TT-NB-L2cHJ_RuFGOOs2wn0-JJfEpc7DpKSWthyrORoywf1tQkok6W7SUWZvXhex8KsOaBmGdZetrS-udAcNw6gzm6aLnU38qjByHMIhMz5FfRprYxY8acdeLNIKBidLNd6vPqg0O0m_M79pXhuUCQP4ERVUvAg8EfWqtY3JdUbs_nw1kyBMSzrQnNG6ZepJ4lvjombLOpm4ygjxSnPJSMuL9tTVG6-KvmLgDk03X3sXpgmacvd2UhJkU1hFw%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f97a4b93c1ba46b4b84dc0597e8e80df&_e=xUrftfK2XJNNfTBKTJVDGCW0L0us_5_ZCebamklgCxHyMvZMaIl37RBE2r7wVjL9vH9f_H0dnkErbgYGxCunb66ByJCtt0qwA7X50ZtxP69GVXfxNm89TDUm5Fncbm_fd8JIn0-hjhv_cY3XbAZj5MKi5TT-NB-L2cHJ_RuFGOOs2wn0-JJfEpc7DpKSWthyrORoywf1tQkok6W7SUWZvXhex8KsOaBmGdZetrS-udCaAN1azg-twHLlizQVI29i23AwN-rUKhRvT_F6O2OccM8H5xBn5gT3idjMQmF9bWzRUpVXF6DrAFDDqVehqSn25bGY8rJyxynROHwiKqV_4EJ9RoJJzXs5Mjl0Cq3ebzYeFu74BnJJPz0tFJNZqQer_X8T7FLn_F8oixqT5t453A%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Hard-working Americans like you – lending your support through emails like this one just _[$25](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMDM2MzY0NTQ0ODE2NzE2NzU3JmM9bzZnMyZlPTAmYj0xMDE1MzE5MjMxJmQ9dDBqM20wdA==.onILIigg90IfftcgVJqh4HFApEZzjizpg2SWyac46gQ)_ , _[$10](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMDM2MzY0NTQ0ODE2NzE2NzU3JmM9bzZnMyZlPTAmYj0xMDE1MzE5MjM3JmQ9aTVjOW43bA==.mwP88GFDmryQwAdjsrwzT_3T6l2QZmzmyfrWMwUM_SI)_ , or _[even $2](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMDM2MzY0NTQ0ODE2NzE2NzU3JmM9bzZnMyZlPTAmYj0xMDE1MzE5MjQxJmQ9eDhxOHgycQ==.076dcjVB5pf_mqbBiIXf0jbjoOXAcylN5pH31S-sjro)_ at a time – have been helping us knock on doors, train volunteers, register voters, and take all other steps necessary to win in November. You power this campaign, Derek. Your investment is going to be the key to getting leadership that brings New Hampshire to Washington... _Not the other way around!_ Elections are won through voter contacts and outreach, and you are setting us up for success by helping fund those operations. **Can I also give you one final reason why keeping up that support is so important?** **__Many are saying that this race in New Hampshire is the key for helping Republicans flip the Majority in the U.S. Senate.__** **A completely new and improved direction for our country is what’s on the table!** Derek, that’s why your grassroots contribution of _[even just a few bucks](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yMDM2MzY0NTQ0ODE2NzE2NzU3JmM9bzZnMyZlPTAmYj0xMDE1MzE5MjQ2JmQ9aTVnNHQzZA==.jtKgHDEeiy-7SzAngQRq3PqmjktIG2zvwaTqi7Qmeqc)_ is more than a political contribution. If that’s a change you’d like to see, I’m humbly asking you to click the button below and continue your essential support for this fight. _Let’s go win this race by using something that Maggie Hassan still doesn’t understand... Peter,
As promised, Labor Day marked the unofficial start of the election season – things are heating up, and this week was packed with a picnic, parade, and plenty of interviews!
We kicked off last weekend with some canvassing! If you want to help out with our massive voter outreach efforts, let us know here [https://secure.ngpvan.com/VGN6z1lOhkW2EkSFTGs0mw2] ! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/canvassing%20090322_edit_1.jpg]
Wade attended church in Savannah on Sunday with State Rep. William Boddie, candidate for GA Labor Commissioner, and State Rep. Bee Nguyen, candidate for GA Secretary of State. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/church%20090422_edit_1.jpg]
We then headed to the Savannah Regional Central Labor Council Labor Day picnic! Wade was happy to speak with union members and local elected officials about the impact of organized labor and the continuing fight for workers’ rights. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/labor%20picnic_edit_1.jpg]
On Thursday, Wade spent the day in & around Brunswick interviewing with local papers Brunswick News [https://thebrunswicknews.com/news/local_news/herring-stops-in-the-golden-isles/article_2d2cc8cd-609a-590f-a0db-a50b39bcd133.html] & Darien News, The Yolanda Neely Show, and local radio WCGA. Then he headed to Townsend for the McIntosh County Democrats monthly meeting! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/radio_edit.gif]
To wrap up the week – today we were on Tybee Island for their Equality Fest! Wade and Women for Wade marched in the parade with the message “Freedom is on the Ballot.” [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/w4w%20parade%20tybee_edit_1.jpg]

We cannot afford to pay the record-high bills he's racking up. _Whether it's expensive student loan plans or countless billions sent over to Ukraine with ZERO accountability, it's TOO much. _

[ stdin# ][IMG]

Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Fighting Manchin’s Dirty Deal | Hey DNC: Ban Dark Money! |
Swing State Fund! | General Election BLUEPRINT! | Rhode Island Votes Tues
| St. Louis Votes Tues | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1011&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ][IMG]

RSVP now for our Special Town Hall to Take Action Stop Manchin’s Dirty
Deal with frontline community activists, US Rep. Ro Khanna, and Greenpeace
USA’s Tefere Gebre — this Thursday at 8:30p ET/5:30 PT.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7583?t=1012&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ]RSVP HERE

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1013&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ][IMG]

Our Revolution is leading the charge alongside frontline communities and
environmental justice groups like Greenpeace to kill Joe Manchin’s side
deal for more dirty oil favors.

Manchin is willing to shut down the government for more fossil fuel
projects like the Mountain Valley Pipeline in WV and strip safeguards from
impacted communities.

Dems can’t celebrate “the biggest climate steps in history” while
reversing them by caving to a literal coal baron.

Our coalition of 650 organizations is urging Senate Majority Leader Chuck
Schumer to detach the deal from the must-pass bill to fund the government
— we cannot let Manchin hold us hostage!

Bernie railed against it on the Senate floor this week and says he’ll vote
it down, and Our Revolution is calling for a progressive mutiny in
Congress.

A coalition of 72 US House Reps have signed onto a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7584?t=1014&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ]letter led by US
Rep. Raul Grijalva - but we need more of our representatives in Congress
to stand in opposition.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7585?t=1015&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ]CALL YOUR HOUSE REP

* Don’t fast-track new gas or oil projects
* Don’t fast-track carbon pipelines
* Don’t cut safeguards for impacted communities
* Separate the deal from the must-pass bill to fund the government
* Sign US Rep. Grijalva’s letter

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1016&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1017&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ][IMG]

OUR FIGHT TO BAN DARK MONEY

A DNC committee blocked a vote on our resolution to Ban Dark Money from
Democratic Primaries — a top priority of our members and the grassroots of
the Party.

Now, the real work begins. Our Revolution Board members Larry Cohen and
Jane Kleeb are helping lead a coalition of 33 progressive DNC members to
fight for this resolution. “The 33 of us are not going to stand down just
because the resolution committee pulled a fast one,” Nina Turner told
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7586?t=1018&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ]Common Dreams.

Democrats can’t be the Party of democracy in one breath and then allow an
astronomical amount of money from Republican megadonors and corporate
interests to flood their own primaries.

We have powerful support from Bernie, Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, and
others behind us - but we need the grassroots to rise up!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7582?t=1019&akid=3375%2E5885482%2ENNi0dF ][IMG]

It’s evident that the DNC has no issue with dark money targeting
progressive candidates in their primaries — but they can’t ignore the
party base and this blatant hypocrisy.

Despite an avalanche of dark money targeting progressives, we clinched
critical wins in the 2022 primaries with folks like Greg Casar (TX-35),
Summer Lee (PA-12), and many others.

But, we also saw dark money blanket whole districts with smears against
some of our most-beloved candidates, erasing 30-point leads in a
campaign's final weeks.

Peter,

More than ten years ago, I stepped off the bus and into Officer Basic Training to become a Marine.

During Officer Basic Training, I went through weapons and combat training, extensive military history classes, and drill – but beyond all the physical training, I was taught that **everything is earned, never given**.

After countless hours, too many pull-ups to count, and hard work – I was commissioned as an Officer, got my official pin, and earned my spot in the Marines. It wasn’t easy. _Things that are great rarely are._

Today, I’m training to serve my country in a different capacity. Instead of weapons and combat training, I’m knocking on doors, and talking to constituents. Rather than history lessons, I’m sending emails just like this one. I subbed out pull-ups for putting up campaign signs.

All this training is still for the same purpose: **to serve Americans and protect our great nation from threats both foreign and domestic.**

During Officer Basic Training, I went through weapons and combat training, extensive military history classes, and drill – but beyond all the physical training, I was taught that everything is earned, never given. After countless hours, too many pull-ups to count, and hard work – I was commissioned as an Officer, got my official pin, and earned my spot in the Marines. It wasn’t easy. | It’s official. The state senate has passed a dangerous and unpopular near-total abortion ban in South Carolina. Now, it goes back to the state house.

This is a disgrace for every woman in our state and the cost of inaction is too great.

This legislation makes it more difficult for doctors to provide reproductive care, and requires doctors who provide services to victims of rape and incest to report the situation to law enforcement and provide them with DNA samples... _and it wasn’t even the worst version of the bill they were considering._

**They are trying to turn S.C. into a police state, and we have to step up, unify, and fight back at the ballot box.**

My opponent, Nancy Mace, helped write the near-total abortion ban and has consistently voted against our abortion rights since entering Congress. The strongest message South Carolinians can send now is to vote anti-abortion Mace out of power.

My team is organizing across the Lowcountry right now to do just that and I just got the endorsement of Planned Parenthood in this crucial race, because I would never let politicians decide what we can and can’t do with our bodies.

As a doctor, I know these decisions should be kept between patients and their healthcare providers. The decision Republicans like Mace want us to make is between women dying because they can’t get an abortion and doctors being jailed if they provide one.
