Peter,
I've been hearing a lot of chirping coming from California about Florida.

For a state government that can't even keep their lights on, they sure have a lot to say about a state that does things right.

The same California government that begged Floridians to move to their state to enjoy their "freedom" actually issued mandates for citizens to turn off their A/C, refrain from using appliances, and turn off their lights after 4:00 pm.

_**Is that the "freedom" they were referring to?**_

They also asked owners of electric vehicles not to charge their cars during this time because their state power grid couldn't handle it. This comes just a week after the announcement that California is banning the sale of gas-powered cars.

The state that forces you to buy an electric vehicle turned around and immediately banned the use of charging stations because their state infrastructure is not equipped to handle it.

It was only a matter of time before the same blue states who wanted to lock you down from COVID would start finding a new public emergency to tighten their control.
* Dictating your means of transportation
* Limiting your ability to use your transportation
* Controlling when and what appliances and energy you use in your own home

_**That sounds more like a third-world dictatorship than a state within the most developed country in the world.**_

But that's the Democrat gameplan. Friend,

Today we're going to talk about classified documents and, in particular, the egregious theft of those documents by ex-President Trump. I've had a security clearance at various levels for over 10 years. Document control (ie, not taking classified documents out of classified workspaces) is incredibly important. The world is full of actors who would love to know what the US government does, and it's up to every cleared individual to protect the information we use. That means various restrictions: proper access control to documents, proper storage, and even protecting information from inadvertent disclosure (no cell phones near classified!). **Given that background, it's absolutely clear to me that Trump should be in jail. Putting aside whether he sold or lost the contents of the now-empty classified folders, or if just "kept the folders as "momentos." The classified information he did keep posed a serious threat to national security.** The man stole nuclear documents and kept them in his house! Anyone else would be in jail for what he did, but instead he has a young, incompetent, and biased judge protecting him. Trump doesn't need a special master, and every delay is yet another example of the rich and powerful getting away with crimes that would (rightfully) be punished if they had been committed by normal Americans. I swore an oath to protect this country from all enemies, foreign and domestic. It has been clear for years that Trump always put America last when it came to his own self-interest. It is painfully obvious now: from Ukraine (impeachment #1), to his actions January 6 (impeachment #2), and now to the documents he squirreled away to Mar-a-Lago. clean_body: The man stole nuclear documents and kept them in his house! | | Friend, Today we're going to talk about classified documents and, in particular, the egregious theft of those documents by ex-President Trump. I've had a security clearance at various levels for over 10 years. Document control (ie, not taking classified documents out of classified workspaces) is incredibly important. The world is full of actors who would love to know what the US government does, and it's up to every cleared individual to protect the information we use. That means various restrictions: proper access control to documents, proper storage, and even protecting information from inadvertent disclosure (no cell phones near classified!). Given that background, it's absolutely clear to me that Trump should be in jail. Putting aside whether he sold or lost the contents of the now-empty classified folders, or if just "kept the folders as "momentos." The classified information he did keep posed a serious threat to national security. The man stole nuclear documents and kept them in his house! Anyone else would be in jail for what he did, but instead he has a young, incompetent, and biased judge protecting him. Trump doesn't need a special master, and every delay is yet another example of the rich and powerful getting away with crimes that would (rightfully) be punished if they had been committed by normal Americans. I swore an oath to protect this country from all enemies, foreign and domestic. It has been clear for years that Trump always put America last when it came to his own self-interest. It is painfully obvious now: from Ukraine (impeachment #1), to his actions January 6 (impeachment #2), and now to the documents he squirreled away to Mar-a-Lago. And yet this judge, like most Republican politicians, continues to protect Trump from the consequences of his own actions. There is Trumpism rot in the judiciary, and Trumpism rot in Congress. If American democracy is going to survive, we need to turn out and vote in November. subject: DC Event Canceled, Wildfire Help in SW Washington
body:
Dear Supporter,

Due to the dangerous wildfires that have broken out in my district, I'm cancelling my September 13th fundraiser in DC. We will reschedule for a date later this month if this situation clears up.

If any of you are in SW Washington, I encourage you to pay careful attention to the news and ensure you and your loved ones are out of harms way.

Monitor your local stations to stay up to date on evacuation notices. Listen to WZ2502 (162.425) for Goat Rock updates, WNG604 (162.525) for Kalama updates, KHB60 (162.550) for King updates, and WXN21 (162.400) for Snohomish updates.

My staff and I are volunteering to help with families with evacuations. If you're able to join us, please email back your name and cell phone number and we'll help you get organized.

Thank you and please pray for those affected by these forest fires.

Respectfully,

Joe Kent

body:
The reason this matters is because right now, Ron Johnson’s campaign and his allies are flooding the airwaves with ads.
| Friends:

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution directly to my campaign to defeat Ron Johnson in Wisconsin. Please give me a chance to explain why this request -- especially today -- is so important.

Here is the truth:

At the end of this month, we face a critical FEC fundraising deadline, and we have some very big goals to meet before it ends.

The reason this matters is because right now, Ron Johnson's campaign and his allies are flooding the airwaves with ads. We have ads up too, but not to the level of everyone trying to beat us.

So tomorrow, my campaign is going to make a few important budget decisions. And honestly, what we can afford to do, and what we can't afford to do, could be the difference in this race.

This campaign is funded by lots of people making online donations, but we need more people doing their part. We need you. Today if you can. We must act now to ensure that same-sex couples retain the same rights as everybody else. name: Herschel Walker
subject: There’s nothing quite like it
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
I’ll never forget what it felt like to play for the Georgia Bulldogs on the historic Dooley Field at Sanford Stadium, in front of 90,000 screaming fan |
---
[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=2e9a752e12634c4ca04ead07c459a9fa&_e=q-227vOuiiBHmKR8jQ4I17p5Yl_hpVEByYpyS0tnUKM5xT8Uz-s-bfzcL-AKcjwMU7ZauiGtncpc3gP6nGPwNd8H4zZRfuAYUHDLb7jIPaokKOgRmIlCmf78gi-lqcBQHgGNWYcAz50aIo9VuP9jJpvo4dIwfoVK7C018QBlVg9zc5DvR9aEZr7sp9VWZr1Ss_pyNXF1NGaIV-cuwhxAmOiFIOuHg8aXeSklJvRQpEdw4LnQUF5ySos2kBOHzawBOgFHgf4DzMRPOxLcjRClv6Rmu4UOPHw2dUB8Xnjt5LjXgwkZj9vyekE94DXQF_FGCgYrEQa5djLtf8nrSgSpcBVvjhEAHBRimafq0bU1N2ALA1h7th95PdrsNPSkcTWrNQVKPjT4YHakoJf9evLFs8W7tR9P0Itrmi5iU7sc3l4PtAvSv69T3CBdjYub-jL_)

Fellow American,

Saturdays during football season are special. _There is nothing quite like Saturdays when the Bulldogs are playing - especially being a Bulldog on a Saturday night after a Georgia win. _

* Gas was cheap.
* Grocery stores were stocked with fairly-priced food.
* Interest rates were low.
* The economy was booming.

* Gas topped off at around $10 per gallon in some places.

body:
Less than 59 days to the election!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter _,_ President Biden has renewed the call he made, in a speech that Trump said was, **“the most vicious, hateful and divisive speech ever delivered by an American president.” **Biden said again this weekend: “I ran for President because I believed we were in a battle for the soul of this nation. I still believe that to be true. **MAGA Republicans are a clear and present danger to our democracy. But we have the power to stop their assault on America.”** **Biden has been compared to Satan and Hitler for talking about the MAGA Republican assault on our voting rights and democratic traditions, but he and the Democratic National Committee are still going to fight hard for us in November. They’re not giving up on this country. How about you?** **[Can you stand with President Biden, by donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta969af2e-3dfb-4fbb-a192-706eed2a1e58/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. **_Baby killer. Communist. Christ Killer. America Hater. Libt*rd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers._ ** **_But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last week Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. They're not used to this! So they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing._**
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE NOW: STAND WITH BIDEN & THE DNC!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T90f0c2a9-8a2d-43d2-8a43-b97eb98ba4f2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Biden’s speech an incredible development, and one of which we should all be proud. I have talked on this list before about how our lack of messaging about our achievements, and about who they really are, hurts us in elections. Well, with some of the younger Democrats like Reps. Ruben Gallego, Eric Swalwell and Katie Porter, Senators like Cory Booker and Brian Schatz and Governors and candidates like Beto O'Rourke, Stacey Abrams, John Fetterman & Gretchen Whitmer leading the way, we are changing the culture of our party. _If I could sum it up, I'd quote the late Patrick Swayze from the film Road House. "Be nice. Until it's time not to be nice."_ **_Sometimes, you need to punch a bully in the nose. And that's what we're now doing. So as a HUGE THANK YOU for Joe Biden's speech and strength in standing by his words, I'd like to ask you to join us in donating to the Democratic National Committee (DNC) today. It feels very much like they're ready to roll, and roll over Republicans, in November. _** [**They got our message, let's make sure we reinforce it with financial support so they have the resources to win an overwhelming victory in November! So can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T92f679e1-b534-4562-b6c4-596dcf84a94a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation."
